patch_description:
Add a compact congestion regularizer based on two-node cuts. In a valid topology, the pair {i,j} has 4 − x_ij − x_ji links crossing its boundary in each direction. If D is its larger incoming or outgoing external demand, D/(4 − x_ij − x_ji) is a congestion lower bound. Its square has an exact quadratic expansion, with linear coefficient 7D²/144 and reciprocal-link coefficient 13D²/144.

This adds pressure against reciprocal bottlenecks, particularly between busy nodes, while retaining the existing demand-aware route model. Normalize by maximum incident demand for size-independent weights, and remove degree-invariant node offsets from the added linear terms so they do not unnecessarily bias sampling. The change adds at most n(n−1)/2 couplings, without adding degree penalties.
